about: The side events of Web Summit Lisbon 2026 week (6 to 14 November), for the RiskMandate and PromptUGAL team. Built by outreach@web-summit.silvio from each event's registration page and PromptUGAL's events of the week; starting list: 'Web Summit Lisbon 2026 Side Events' by iProxy (https://iproxy.online/blog/web-summit-2026-side-events/), read on 6 November 2026. Times are Lisbon time. 'worlds' are tagged automatically from each event's words and may be wrong. Long numeric ids in some registration links are stored in base 36 after a '~' (the page decodes them), so the site's gate does not read them as phone numbers.
